hooks.name: Check requirements on save
hooks.description: Compiles every EARS line with npx --no-install golem-spec check. Timeout 30 s: compile only, no trial runs; the Tiny_Test_App needs well under 1 s.

hooks.name: Falsify controller on save
hooks.description: Runs npx --no-install golem-spec test --budget 24 after a controller file is saved. Timeout 300 s: 24 trials per requirement at up to 2 s of simulated time each. Raise it for a slower app.

hooks.name: Gate the agent
hooks.description: Runs npx --no-install golem-spec gate --kiro when the agent tries to stop; a red gate blocks the stop with the counterexamples. Timeout 300 s: pinned seeds plus the 24-trial quick budget per requirement.

hooks.name: Test after spec task
hooks.description: Runs npx --no-install golem-spec test after a spec task finishes. Timeout 300 s: the default of 64 trials per requirement. The hook runs in the workspace root, so install the kit there (npx --no-install golem-spec init) or the Config_Locator finds no app.

hooks.name: Summon the ghosts
hooks.description: Manual long campaign: npx --no-install golem-spec test --budget 256. Timeout 1800 s: 256 trials per requirement.
